changelog:
- Initial release of brand-knowledge-base skill, version 1.0.2.
- Added all core templates, prompt files, and output formats for building a reusable brand knowledge package.
- Provides intake templates (JSON, MD, YAML) and guides users to supply minimum required company information before knowledge extraction.
- Generates standardized outputs: brand_knowledge_base (MD/JSON/YAML), FAQ, glossary, standard messaging, llms.txt, and analysis report.
- Marks missing fields as "待确认" and provides follow-up questions in the analysis report if required data is not provided.
- Enforces safety rules: no invention of facts, conservative wording, strong disclaimers for regulated industries, and human review before production use.
summary: Build a reusable brand knowledge package from uploaded brand documents and/or a filled intake form. Use when the user wants a standardized brand SSOT contain...
